heroHeadline: From complex challenges to real business outcomes.
heroSubtext: Across technology, operations and emerging industries, I have worked from the leadership table to the operating floor, diagnosing difficult problems, building the response and making change work in practice.
heroSupportingParagraph: I work with CEOs, founders and leadership teams on business transformation, growth strategy, operational excellence and technology-led change. My experience spans e-commerce, supply chains, robotics, digital platforms and emerging industries, including cultivated meat and alternative proteins.

careerJourney.statement: Learned the customer and commercial reality that every later transformation depends on.
Built Same-Day and Next-Day delivery as a customer proposition, not just a logistics metric.
Introduced machine-led decision-making into a live operation, redesigning the work alongside the technology.
Connected Design, Procurement, Manufacturing and After-Sales around a single operating backbone.
Commercial and operating work across acquisitions inside a large-scale digital platform.
Reframed a cultivated-meat startup from a consumer ambition toward an ingredient-led B2B/B2G model.
Rebuilt an institution's operating model and digital infrastructure while it continued to run.
